state:
**Side goal `narrow-a-readonly-property`, stage 2 has one item left.** E0782 refuses every `readonly` write the checker can see: through another receiver, after construction, through a property key (`crates/nvs-types/src/expr/assign.rs`, `reject_readonly_write`), and a second write on one constructor path, inside a loop, over a promoted parameter, and as an element write (`$this->list[0] = v`), all in `crates/nvs-types/src/ctor_init.rs` (`InitState::write`, `this_property_written`; the module doc says how). E0843 refuses a hook on `readonly`. These writers were checked and need no change: a write inside an anonymous function is E0782 ("after construction"); destructuring into a property is E0105; `clone` is a shallow copy with no hook (`rule:classes/clone-is-shallow`); `Core\Json::decodeAs` into a class and the database row fill both run the constructor; the graph decoder rebuilds an object that was already built.
**The hole still open is the writers the checker cannot see.** An erased receiver writes a `readonly` property with no check: `object $o = $b; $o->v = 9;` prints `9` (run here). `Core\Reflect\ClassInfo::set` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs:2812`) reaches the same `write_erased_property` (found by search, not run). `ClassDesc` has no `readonly` bit (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/object.rs:304`). Stages 3 and 4 are untouched. In this worktree the `extension` step of `bun nv verify` fails because `@types/node` is not installed. That is the environment, not the change.

next.title: `readonly` is written once
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-runtime/src/object.rs`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs`, plus wherever codegen builds `ClassDesc`'s field list.

items.text: **A run-time `readonly` bit for erased writes**: give `ClassDesc` one flag per field, set from `crate::signatures::property_is_readonly` where the field names are emitted. Then make the erased writes throw an `Error` naming the property when the flag is set: `nvs_object_slot_set`, `nvs_object_key_set`, `write_erased_property`, and so `ClassInfo::set`. PHP throws `Error: Cannot modify readonly property C::$p` here. The graph decoder (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/graph.rs:931`) is construction and stays exempt. Cost: one bit per field per class, once per process, and one test on the erased write path, which is already the slow path. Add a reject-style runtime `.nvst` for the `object` receiver and for reflection. `rule:classes/lateinit-restrictions` — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/object.rs:304`, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/object.rs:5028`, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/object.rs:4629`, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/object.rs:4743`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs:2812`
**Stage 3 starts once this is closed**: a null test narrows a path of `readonly` links (`rule:types/narrowing`) — `crates/nvs-types/src/locals.rs:1`

backlog: Stage 3: the checked narrowed read in nvs-ir (`narrowed_property_reads` test target), after the checker narrows (goal record, stage 3).
Stage 4: E0459's help on a tested mutable property shows the local copy and `?->` (goal record, stage 4).
`bun nv goal context --add` writes to the chain's live goal, not to a side goal, so stage 2's `context.modules` was widened by hand (`data/goals/side/narrow-a-readonly-property.json`).
